newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Rate on 91-day Bahrain t-bills rises to 5.75 pct.
newsitem.headline: Rate on 91-day Bahrain t-bills rises to 5.75 pct.

text.p: The average yield at this week's tender for 10 million dinars of 91-day Bahrain treasury bills rose to 5.75 percent from 5.71 percent a week ago, a spokesman for the Bahrain Monetary Agency said on Monday.
The average price dropped to 98.567 from 98.577 and the minimum price accepted was 98.552.
Banks submitted bids for 18.3 million dinars worth of bills, down from 22.98 million dinars the previous week.
The bills, maturing on July 9, were offered on Monday and will be issued on Wednesday.
